label: 25 May, Eodem die — S. Mariae Magdalenae de Pazzi, Virginis

chants.notes: The Graduale prints 'AL. Adducentur regi, 511.' but p511 (Commune Sanctorum et Sanctarum, Versus alleluiatici) engraves only 'Beatus vir qui suffert' (I) and 'Beatus vir qui timet' (II) -- it holds no Adducentur. The alleluia 'Adducentur regi virgines post eam' is engraved on p500 (Commune Virginum, Versus alleluiatici I, mode III, gregobase 208). target_page is recorded as 500, the page that actually carries the chant; the printed 511 appears to be a page-number misprint. Flagged for a ruling.
